Convert Beaufort Number to Description

beaufort_to_description.Rd

Maps Beaufort scale integers (0-12) to standard descriptions.

Usage

beaufort_to_description(beaufort)

Arguments

beaufort

Integer vector of Beaufort numbers (0-12).

Value

Character vector of Beaufort descriptions.

See also

Other storm-alert: create_storm_alert_email(), detect_storm_events(), fetch_all_forecasts(), fetch_met_eireann_warnings(), fetch_open_meteo_forecast(), knots_to_beaufort(), send_storm_alert()

Examples

beaufort_to_description(0:12)
#>  [1] "Calm"            "Light Air"       "Light Breeze"    "Gentle Breeze"  
#>  [5] "Moderate Breeze" "Fresh Breeze"    "Strong Breeze"   "Near Gale"      
#>  [9] "Gale"            "Strong Gale"     "Storm"           "Violent Storm"  
#> [13] "Hurricane Force"
